lines.text: David, Israel's king, opens by saying the LORD is his shepherd, so he shall not want, and friend, that's one well-fed sheep.
The LORD makes David lie down in green pastures, leads him beside quiet waters, and restores his soul.
David says that even when he walks through the valley of Elah, he will fear no evil because the LORD is with him, and the rod and staff comfort him.

wrong_details.true: the valley of the shadow of death

lines.text: Now the LORD is the host: He prepares a table for David in the presence of his enemies, anoints his head with oil, and David's cup overflows.
David closes by saying goodness and mercy will follow him all the days of his life, and he will dwell in the land of Goshen forever.
